stations.title: Radio desk
stations.text: Three people typing, no two lines alike.

stations.title: Rhona
stations.note: Seen as soon as it came in.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa asks which of tonight's entries Rhona has to see straight away.
Today every line is typed a different way, so the urgent call from Echo one gets lost.
You write small functions that tidy text, find the colon and spot the urgent words.
Now Echo one's call is picked out and goes straight to Rhona.
Every line from the radio desk reads one way, and Rhona sees the urgent ones first.
